positive.user_prompt: Connect FlowAccount securely and show its qualified capabilities.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_mercury_context -> list_accounting_providers -> start_provider_connection -> secure authorization_url/setup_url -> list_provider_connections -> connector_status -> list_provider_capabilities. First use opens secure Mercury sign-in and provider credentials remain encrypted server-side.
positive.expected_result_shape: A tenant-bound connection with a secure handoff, sanitized status, and only its qualified capabilities.
positive.fixture: A signed-in Mercury tenant starts a FlowAccount or PEAK connection without providing any credential in chat.

positive.user_prompt: Show whether this connected provider can read invoices and the reviewed schema version.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_provider_capabilities followed by get_capability_schema for the selected workspace and connection. Return only an exact qualified capability and reviewed versioned schema.
positive.expected_result_shape: Connection-scoped capability state, version, and schema with no unqualified action claim.
positive.fixture: The selected connection has a qualified documents.invoice.list capability.

positive.user_prompt: Run the company health Skill for my selected connected provider.
positive.expected_behavior: Use run_accounting_skill with the selected connection and only the required qualified read capability. Keep results cited and sanitized.
positive.expected_result_shape: A cited accounting result or an explicit qualification requirement, with no arbitrary provider write.
positive.fixture: The workspace has one ready connection with the Skill's exact qualified read capability.

positive.user_prompt: Prepare an invoice from my qualified connection, render the immutable preview for my review, create it only after my explicit confirmation, then show the operation status.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_provider_capabilities and get_capability_schema, then follow prepare_document_create -> render_document_preview -> confirm_document_create -> get_operation_status. The provider create cannot happen until explicit confirmation of the immutable preview version.
positive.expected_result_shape: A capability-gated immutable preview, then one explicitly confirmed create and a sanitized operation status. Only render_document_preview may use custom UI on supported hosts; all other stages have text and structured output.
positive.fixture: The selected connection may or may not qualify for documents.invoice.create.

positive.user_prompt: Summarize Thai input VAT review requirements with citations and identify missing evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Use retrieve_context_pack or search_knowledge, preserve citations, and separate sourced facts from accountant review points.
positive.expected_result_shape: Citation-bearing context, missing evidence, and effective-date caveats.
positive.fixture: A signed-in workspace can access reviewed Mercury knowledge.

negative.user_prompt: Here is my ERP client secret; save it and continue setup.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not repeat, pass, or store the secret. Advise rotation and resume through the secure provider authorization flow.
negative.why_not: Provider credentials are encrypted server-side and never enter chat, model, RAG, log, or audit output.

negative.user_prompt: Post a production invoice with this read-only connection now.
negative.expected_behavior: Return provider_capability_unavailable. Do not invent a capable connection or claim a provider write.
negative.why_not: A read capability does not grant the exact qualified document-create capability.

negative.user_prompt: Skip the preview and confirmation and create the invoice now.
negative.expected_behavior: Require prepare_document_create -> render_document_preview -> confirm_document_create -> get_operation_status. Do not dispatch until the user explicitly confirms the displayed immutable preview version.
negative.why_not: Document creation cannot bypass its qualification, preview, confirmation, or status lifecycle.
